item.title: AddItemsToCollection
item.description:
To be used as part of the UpdateCollectionRequest when adding new items. Items in a collection must be unique, repeated items in a payload result in an error.

{
 "items": [
 {
 "type": "album",
 "id": "1234"
 }
 ],
 "to": 6
}
Field Type Req. OpenS. Details
items CollectionItemID[] Yes Yes A list of items. Each item must occur at most once.
to integer No Yes If set and non-negative, the first item in the array will be added at this index; if unset or set to a negative value, items will be appended to the tail of the collection.

item.title: collection
item.description:
Does not contain the items in the collection, look at collectionWithItems instead.

 "id": "800000075",
 "name": "testcollection",

 "changed": "2026-03-16T03:18:41+00:00",
 "itemCount": 3,
 "readonly": true
}
Field Type Req. OpenS. Details
id string Yes Id of the collection
name string Yes Name of the collection
comment string No A commnet
owner string No Owner of the collection
public boolean No Is the collection public
itemCount int Yes number of items
created string Yes Creation date [ISO 8601]
changed string Yes Last changed date [ISO 8601]
coverArt string No A cover Art Id
readonly boolean No If true the collection cannot be edited by the current user

When readonly is true, clients should hide or disable UI actions that modify the collection. The value should reflect the current authenticated user’s access level. When omitted, clients should assume the collection is editable (false).

item.title: CollectionItemID
item.description:
When the ‘id’ field is not present for an item type (e.g. Genre), use its name or some other natural identifier.

{
 "type": "song",
 "id": "20"
}
{
 "type": "album",
 "id": "30"
}
{
 "type": "genre",
 "id": "vaporwave"
}
Field Type Req. OpenS. Details
type string Yes One of: song, album, artist, playlist, genre, internetRadioStation, podcastEpisode, podcast.
id string Yes ID (or name, if ‘id’ is not available) of an item.

item.title: createCollection
item.description:
http://your-server/rest/createCollection

Creates a collection. This endpoint must be accessed using an HTTP POST request.

Request Body

The request payload should be provided in the body as a JSON object, as specified by the CreateCollectionRequest schema.

{
 "name": "test collection",
 "comment": "this is a collection",
 "items": [
 {
 "type": "song",
 "id": "300000060"
 },
 {
 "type": "album",
 "id": "200000021"
 },
 {
 "type": "genre",
 "id": "vaporwave"
 }
 ]
}

Example request

`POST http://your-server/rest/createCollection.view?u=demo&p=demo&v=1.16.1&c=AwesomeClientName&f=json`

Result

A subsonic-response element with a top-level collection object on success.

item.title: CreateCollectionRequest
item.description:
Should be used in the CreateCollection endpoint. Items in a collection must be unique, repeated items in a payload result in an error.

{
 "name": "test collection",
 "comment": "this is a collection",
 "items": [
 {
 "type": "song",
 "id": "300000060"
 },
 {
 "type": "album",
 "id": "200000021"
 },
 {
 "type": "genre",
 "id": "vaporwave"
 }
 ]
}
Field Type Req. OpenS. Details
name string Yes Yes The human-readable name of the collection.
comment string No Yes The collection comment.
public boolean No Yes true if the collection should be visible to all users, false otherwise. Default false.
items CollectionItemID[] No Yes A list of items. Each item must occur at most once.

item.title: deleteCollection
item.description:
http://your-server/rest/deleteCollection

Deletes a collection.

Parameters

Parameter Req. OpenS. Default Comment
id Yes ID of the collection to delete, as obtained by getCollections.

Example

`http://your-server/rest/deleteCollection.view?id=123&u=demo&p=demo&v=1.13.0&c=AwesomeClientName&f=json`

Result

An empty subsonic-response element on success.

{
 "subsonic-response": {
 "status": "ok",
 "version": "1.16.1",
 "type": "AwesomeServerName",
 "serverVersion": "0.1.3 (tag)",
 "openSubsonic": true
 }
}

item.title: getCollection
item.description:
http://your-server/rest/getCollection

Returns a collection with the items it contains.

Parameters

Parameter Req. OpenS. Default Comment
id Yes ID of the collection to return, as obtained by getCollections.
itemCount No The number of items from the collection to return. If unset or set to a negative value, return all items.
itemOffset No The number of items to skip.

Example

`http://your-server/rest/getCollection.view?id=123&u=demo&p=demo&v=1.13.0&c=AwesomeClientName&f=json`

Result

A subsonic-response element with a top-level collection object of type collectionWithItems

item.title: getCollections
item.description:
http://your-server/rest/getCollections

Returns collections a user has access to, with optional filters and pagination.

Parameters

Parameter Req. OpenS. Default Comment
username No If specified, return collections for this user rather than for the authenticated user. The authenticated user must have admin role if this parameter is used.
name No If specified, return collections that have the provided string in their name.
sort No name If specified, sort the list by the provided field or randomly. Sorting is applied before the count and offset parameters are taken into account. Use the seed parameter to ensure reproducibility. The default is to sort by name. Allowed values: name, created, random.
order No asc The order of sorting. Allowed values: asc, desc.
seed No The seed used when sorting randomly.
count No The number of collections to return. If unset or set to a negative value, return all collections.
offset No The number of collections to skip.

Example

`http://your-server/rest/getCollections.view?count=2&u=demo&p=demo&v=1.13.0&c=AwesomeClientName&f=json`

Result

A subsonic-response element with a top-level collections array of collection elements on success.

item.title: updateCollection
item.description:
http://your-server/rest/updateCollection

Updates a collection. Only the owner of a collection is allowed to update it. This endpoint must be accessed using an HTTP POST request.

Request Body

The request payload should be provided in the body as a JSON object, as specified by the UpdateCollectionRequest schema.

{
 "collectionId": "23785995",
 "name": "new name",
 "comment": "this is a new comment"
}
{
 "collectionId": "23785995",
 "setItems": [
 {
 "type": "song",
 "id": "300000060"
 },
 {
 "type": "album",
 "id": "200000021"
 },
 {
 "type": "genre",
 "id": "vaporwave"
 }
 ]
}
{
 "collectionId": "23785995",
 "addItems": {
 "items": [
 {
 "type": "album",
 "id": "1234"
 }
 ],
 "to": 6
 }
}
{
 "collectionId": "23785995",
 "moveItems": {
 "fromStart": 0,
 "fromEnd": 5,
 "to": 20
 }
}
{
 "collectionId": "23785995",
 "removeItems": [0, 1, 2, 6]
}

Example request

`POST http://your-server/rest/updateCollection.view?u=demo&p=demo&v=1.13.0&c=AwesomeClientName&f=json`

Result

An empty subsonic-response element on success.

item.title: UpdateCollectionRequest
item.description:
Should be used in the UpdateCollection endpoint. Only the fields supplied in the request payload will have an effect on a collection.

{
 "collectionId": "23785995",
 "name": "new name",
 "comment": "this is a new comment"
}
{
 "collectionId": "23785995",
 "setItems": [
 {
 "type": "song",
 "id": "300000060"
 },
 {
 "type": "album",
 "id": "200000021"
 },
 {
 "type": "genre",
 "id": "vaporwave"
 }
 ]
}
{
 "collectionId": "23785995",
 "addItems": {
 "items": [
 {
 "type": "album",
 "id": "1234"
 }
 ],
 "to": 6
 }
}
{
 "collectionId": "23785995",
 "moveItems": {
 "fromStart": 0,
 "fromEnd": 5,
 "to": 20
 }
}
{
 "collectionId": "23785995",
 "removeItems": [0, 1, 2, 6]
}
Field Type Req. OpenS. Details
collectionId string Yes Yes The collection ID.
name string No Yes The human-readable name of the collection. Cannot be an empty string.
comment string No Yes The collection comment.
public boolean No Yes true if the collection should be visible to all users, false otherwise.
setItems CollectionItemID[] No Yes Replace the list of items with the ones provided. Each item must occur at most once.
addItems AddItemsToCollection No Yes Add items to the collection.
moveItems MoveRange No Yes Move items from the original position to another in the collection.
removeItesm Array of integer No Yes Remove the items at the specified positions from the collection.

Only one of setItems, addItems, moveItems, and removeItems can be non-empty in a single request.
